recipes.name: Scroll of Fire Bolt
recipes.description: Hurl a mote of fire at a creature. 1d10 fire damage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mage Hand
recipes.description: A spectral floating hand appears and can manipulate objects.

recipes.name: Scroll of Light
recipes.description: Touch an object to make it shed bright light in a 20-foot radius.

recipes.name: Scroll of Magic Missile
recipes.description: Three darts of magical force. Each deals 1d4+1 force damage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Cure Wounds
recipes.description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + spellcasting modifier HP.

recipes.name: Scroll of Shield
recipes.description: Reaction: +5 AC until start of next turn.

recipes.name: Scroll of Detect Magic
recipes.description: Sense presence of magic within 30 feet for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Scroll of Sleep
recipes.description: Roll 5d8; creatures with HP totaling that amount fall asleep.

recipes.name: Scroll of Invisibility
recipes.description: A creature becomes invisible for 1 hour.

recipes.name: Scroll of Hold Person
recipes.description: Paralyze a humanoid on failed Wisdom save.

recipes.name: Scroll of Misty Step
recipes.description: Teleport up to 30 feet as a bonus action.

recipes.name: Scroll of Fireball
recipes.description: 8d6 fire damage in a 20-foot radius. Dex save for half.

recipes.name: Scroll of Counterspell
recipes.description: Interrupt a spell being cast. Auto-success for 3rd level or lower.

recipes.name: Scroll of Revivify
recipes.description: Return a creature dead for less than 1 minute to life with 1 HP.

recipes.name: Scroll of Haste
recipes.description: Double speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dex saves, extra action.

recipes.name: Scroll of Spark Jolt
recipes.description: Snap a crackling spark that leaps to a target. Ranged spell attack; 1d8 lightning damage; ignites tinder.

recipes.name: Scroll of Minor Repair
recipes.description: Mends a break/tear up to 1 ft in any dimension. Restores simple mechanical function.

recipes.name: Scroll of Gust Push
recipes.description: A burst of wind shoves a creature/object 5 ft (STR save negates). Extinguishes small flames.

recipes.name: Scroll of Digital Ping
recipes.description: Detects active constructs and powered devices within 30 ft through thin walls.

recipes.name: Scroll of Shadow Veil
recipes.description: Shroud yourself in flickering shade for 1 minute. Lightly obscured; advantage on Stealth checks in dim light.

recipes.name: Scroll of Barrier Ward
recipes.description: Protective field grants +2 AC for 10 minutes (concentration).

recipes.name: Scroll of Feather Step
recipes.description: Reduce fall speed; negate fall damage up to 60 ft for 1 minute (reaction on fall).

recipes.name: Scroll of Seeker's Mark
recipes.description: Mark a target you can see; know direction and rough distance for 1 hour (no plane crossing).

recipes.name: Scroll of Vine Snare
recipes.description: Conjure grasping roots in a 10-ft square. STR save or be restrained for up to 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Data Scrub
recipes.description: For 10 minutes, you cannot be tracked by mundane sensors or low-tier scrying in a 10-ft aura.

recipes.name: Scroll of Radiant Dart
recipes.description: Launch a radiant mote; 2d6 radiant damage (undead/disguised fiends have disadvantage on save).

recipes.name: Scroll of Hologram Decoy
recipes.description: Create a moving visual-only decoy of yourself (no sound) for 1 minute, controlled as a bonus action.

recipes.name: Scroll of Ice Shards
recipes.description: Cone (15 ft) of razor ice; 2d6 cold damage and speed -10 ft until start of your next turn (CON save half).

recipes.name: Scroll of Silence Field
recipes.description: Create a 20-ft radius zone of magical silence for up to 10 minutes (ritual).

recipes.name: Scroll of Shadow Step
recipes.description: Teleport up to 30 ft between two dim-light or darker spaces you can see.

recipes.name: Scroll of Grav Sling
recipes.description: Hurl a Large or smaller creature 20 ft; 2d6 bludgeoning if it hits a wall; STR save negates.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mirror Veil
recipes.description: Create 2–3 illusory duplicates that confuse attackers (attacks may target duplicates).

recipes.name: Scroll of Healing Surge
recipes.description: Touch restores 2d8 + spellcasting mod HP. Additional creature within 5 ft heals 1d8 (optional).

recipes.name: Scroll of Acid Burst
recipes.description: 10-ft radius splash; 3d6 acid; objects in area take damage unless protected (DEX save half).

recipes.name: Scroll of Detect Thoughts
recipes.description: Read surface thoughts; probe deeper with save. Lasts up to 1 minute (concentration).

recipes.name: Scroll of Lesser Glyph
recipes.description: Inscribe a minor triggered sigil (5-ft area): 2d8 force or 2d6 elemental (of your choice). 24h duration.

recipes.name: Scroll of Gravity Well
recipes.description: Create a 20-ft radius zone for 1 minute. Creatures are pulled 10 ft toward center; 3d6 bludgeoning on fail.

recipes.name: Scroll of Aurora Lance
recipes.description: Beam of prismatic light; 5d8 radiant, and target sheds bright light (disadvantage on Stealth) for 1 minute (CON save half).

recipes.name: Scroll of Spirit Anchor
recipes.description: Target fails CHA save: can’t teleport, phase, or be banished for 1 minute; also prevents death saves advantage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Phase Shift
recipes.description: Become briefly intangible; move through creatures/objects until end of your turn; attacks pass through (no damage).

recipes.name: Scroll of Storm Burst
recipes.description: 10-ft radius burst: 4d6 lightning + 2d6 thunder; creatures made of metal have disadvantage on save.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mass Illusion
recipes.description: Populate a 30-ft cube with moving, sound-capable illusions of a small squad (no touch). 10 minutes (concentration).

recipes.name: Scroll of Recall Object
recipes.description: Teleport a known, unattended object (≤5 lb) from within 1 mile into your hand (fails across planar boundaries).

recipes.name: Scroll of Warded Hideout
recipes.description: Sanctify a 20-ft cube for 8 hours: blocks low-tier scrying/teleport; alarms on intrusion (ritual).

recipes.name: Scroll of Dimensional Door
recipes.description: Teleport yourself and one willing creature up to 500 ft to a space you can visualize.

recipes.name: Scroll of Time Dilation
recipes.description: A 20-ft radius bubble slows enemies (Slow effect) for up to 1 minute (WIS save negates per creature).

recipes.name: Scroll of Bone Armor
recipes.description: Protective necrotic shell grants AC 16 if lower and 20 temp HP for 1 hour (no stealth penalty).

recipes.name: Scroll of Wall of Light
recipes.description: Create a 30-ft long, 10-ft high radiant wall. Passing through deals 4d8 radiant; blinds on failed CON save.

recipes.name: Scroll of Null Field
recipes.description: 30-ft radius zone suppresses spells of 3rd level or lower and dampens higher magic checks (DM discretion), 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mass Healing Array
recipes.description: Up to 6 creatures in 30 ft heal 3d8 + spellcasting mod. Radiant pulse cleanses minor disease/poison.

recipes.name: Scroll of Teleport Beacon
recipes.description: Establish a 24-hour beacon. Teleport effects that know the beacon can arrive without error.

recipes.name: Scroll of Chain Storm
recipes.description: Forking lightning leaps to up to 4 targets within 30 ft; 8d8 lightning (DEX save half).

recipes.name: Scroll of Flesh to Stone
recipes.description: Con save; target becomes restrained, then petrified if it fails multiple saves over duration.

recipes.name: Scroll of Soul Lock
recipes.description: Capture a dying soul in a gem, binding it for later bargaining or release (see DM adjudication).

recipes.name: Scroll of Planar Seal
recipes.description: Seal an active portal or rift for 1 year and 1 day. Powerful beings may contest the seal.

recipes.name: Scroll of Temporal Stasis
recipes.description: Freeze a creature in time indefinitely (until dispelled). Target is immune to damage; cannot act.

recipes.name: Scroll of Quantum Blink
recipes.description: Rapidly flicker between adjacent spaces; until your next turn, attacks against you have disadvantage and you ignore difficult terrain.

recipes.name: Scroll of Holo-Maze
recipes.description: Create a shifting 40-ft cube labyrinth of light; creatures inside treat terrain as heavily obscured; WIS save to navigate.

recipes.name: Scroll of Nanite Repair Surge
recipes.description: Construct/vehicle regains 3d8 HP and mends fractures; organic creatures regain 1d8 HP.

recipes.name: Scroll of Digital Muffle
recipes.description: For 1 hour, your voice and steps are filtered to ambient noise; advantage on Stealth; microphones pick silence.

recipes.name: Scroll of Super Mushroom Growth
recipes.description: Target creature grows to double size for 1 minute, gaining +2 to STR and +1 AC. If used on a mushroom, it grows into a massive platform.

recipes.name: Scroll of Fire Flower Blast
recipes.description: Shoot a stream of fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature takes 3d6 fire damage (DEX save for half). Can be used to melt ice blocks.

recipes.name: Scroll of Star Man Invincibility
recipes.description: Target becomes invulnerable to all damage for 30 seconds. During this time, they glow brightly and move at double speed.

recipes.name: Scroll of 1-Up Resurrection
recipes.description: Bring a creature back to life with 1 HP if used within 1 minute of death. The resurrected creature gains temporary hit points equal to their level.

recipes.name: Scroll of Boo Haunt
recipes.description: Summon a spectral Boo that follows you for 1 minute. The Boo can turn invisible at will and can pass through walls. It can also scare one creature (WIS save or frightened for 1 round).

recipes.name: Scroll of Koopa Shell Defense
recipes.description: Target gains +4 AC for 1 minute as they are encased in a magical Koopa shell. While in the shell, they cant move or attack but are resistant to all damage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Piranha Plant Bite
recipes.description: Conjure a magical Piranha Plant that bites one target within 10 feet. The bite deals 2d8 piercing damage and the target must make a STR save or be grappled.

recipes.name: Scroll of Thwomp Crush
recipes.description: Drop a magical Thwomp on a 10-foot square. Each creature in the area takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage (DEX save for half) and is knocked prone.

recipes.name: Scroll of Bowser Breath
recipes.description: Exhale a 30-foot cone of fire that deals 8d6 fire damage (DEX save for half). The fire lingers, creating difficult terrain for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Iron Legion March
recipes.description: Target up to 6 creatures within 30 feet. They gain +10 movement speed and advantage on saves against being frightened for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Peach Loyalist Light
recipes.description: Create a radiant aura in a 20-foot radius that lasts for 1 minute. Allies in the aura gain +1 to attack rolls and saves against fear.

recipes.name: Scroll of Fawful Chaos Beam
recipes.description: Fire a beam of chaotic energy in a 60-foot line. Each creature takes 6d6 force damage (DEX save for half) and must make a WIS save or be confused for 1 round.

recipes.name: Scroll of Onyx Hand Shadow Cloak
recipes.description: Cloak yourself in shadows for 1 minute. You gain advantage on Stealth checks and can move through shadows as if they were difficult terrain.

recipes.name: Scroll of DK Crew Ground Pound
recipes.description: Jump up to 20 feet in the air and slam down, dealing 3d6 bludgeoning damage in a 10-foot radius (DEX save for half) and knocking creatures prone.

recipes.name: Scroll of Liberated Toads Unity
recipes.description: Target up to 6 allies within 30 feet. They gain advantage on saving throws and ability checks for 1 minute as they work together seamlessly.

recipes.name: Scroll of Crimson Fleet Cannonade
recipes.description: Call down a barrage of magical cannon fire on a 20-foot radius. Each creature takes 8d6 fire damage (DEX save for half). The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Rakasha Spirit Walk
recipes.description: Enter a trance for 1 minute. During this time, your spirit leaves your body and can move up to 100 feet away. Your body is unconscious but cant be harmed. If your spirit is destroyed, you die.

recipes.name: Scroll of Wario Land Greed Grab
recipes.description: Your arms grow comically long for 1 minute. You can reach objects up to 30 feet away and can carry an additional 200 pounds. You also gain advantage on grapple checks.

recipes.name: Scroll of Time War Echo
recipes.description: See a 6-second echo of a past event that occurred in your current location. You can choose to view any time within the last 100 years.

recipes.name: Scroll of Oracle Vision
recipes.description: Gain a cryptic vision of a future event. The DM provides a vague but useful clue about an upcoming challenge or opportunity.

recipes.name: Scroll of Raventree Haunting
recipes.description: Summon a spectral version of a creature that died in Raventree Manor. The spirit can answer questions about the manor or its history for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Supernatural Sovereignty
recipes.description: Create a 30-foot radius zone where supernatural creatures (vampires, werewolves, etc.) have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Iron Mandate
recipes.description: Target creature must make a WIS save or be compelled to follow a single command for 1 minute. The command must be something they could normally do (e.g., "drop your weapon" or "flee").

recipes.name: Scroll of Tea Leaf Illusion
recipes.description: Create an illusory duplicate of yourself that lasts for 1 minute. The duplicate mimics your actions and can speak, but cant attack or cast spells.

recipes.name: Scroll of Dragon Conspiracy
recipes.description: Detect the presence of sonic control devices within 100 feet. If found, you can attempt to disable one device as an action (INT check).

recipes.name: Scroll of Glass Monster Summon
recipes.description: Summon a Glass Monster that lasts for 1 minute. The monster has AC 15, 50 HP, and can make two slam attacks (2d6+3 bludgeoning). It obeys your commands and can move through glass as if it were difficult terrain.

recipes.name: Scroll of Archie's Third Eye
recipes.description: Gain the ability to see through illusions and detect hidden creatures or objects within 60 feet for 1 minute. You also gain advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

recipes.name: Scroll of Waluigi Time
recipes.description: For 1 minute, time flows strangely around you. At the start of each of your turns, roll a d6. On a 1-2, time rewinds 6 seconds. On a 5-6, time fast-forwards 6 seconds. On a 3-4, nothing happens.

recipes.name: Scroll of Kamek's Magic
recipes.description: Transform a creature or object into a random, harmless form for 1 minute. The target must make a WIS save or be transformed into something like a frog, a chair, or a pile of coins.

recipes.name: Scroll of hjumpik's Mushroom Madness
recipes.description: Target creature must make a WIS save or be affected by hallucinogenic spores for 1 minute. They see random illusions and have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

recipes.name: Scroll of Big T's Rage
recipes.description: Target creature enters a rage for 1 minute. They gain +2 to melee damage rolls and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. However, they have disadvantage on INT, WIS, and CHA checks and can only make melee attacks.

recipes.name: Scroll of Dan the Toad's Healing
recipes.description: Touch a creature to heal 2d8 + spellcasting modifier HP. If the target is a toad or amphibian, they heal an additional 1d8 HP.

recipes.name: Scroll of Eager's Pepper Spray
recipes.description: Spray a 15-foot cone of irritating mist. Each creature in the area must make a CON save or be blinded and take 1d6 poison damage for 1 round.

recipes.name: Scroll of Remi's Repair
recipes.description: Repair a broken object or construct, restoring 2d8 + spellcasting modifier HP. If used on a mechanical device, it also regains one use of its primary function.

recipes.name: Scroll of Markop's Shadow Clone
recipes.description: Create 1d4 illusory duplicates of yourself that last for 1 minute. The duplicates mimic your actions and can take one hit before disappearing.

recipes.name: Scroll of Ryan's Stealth
recipes.description: Become invisible for 1 minute or until you attack or cast a spell. While invisible, you have advantage on Stealth checks and can move silently.

recipes.name: Scroll of Bones' Undead Command
recipes.description: Command up to 3 undead creatures within 60 feet for 1 minute. The undead must make a WIS save or obey your commands to the best of their ability.

recipes.name: Scroll of Green T's Venom
recipes.description: Coat a weapon with magical venom. The next hit deals an additional 2d6 poison damage and the target must make a CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Embercap's Flame Dance
recipes.description: Surround yourself with magical flames for 1 minute. You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d6 fire damage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mistveil's Illusion
recipes.description: Create an illusory duplicate of any creature or object you can see within 60 feet. The illusion lasts for 1 minute and can move and act as if it were real (though it cant attack or cast spells).

recipes.name: Scroll of Thornpaw's Spirit Walk
recipes.description: Your spirit leaves your body for 1 minute. Your body is unconscious but cant be harmed. Your spirit can move up to 100 feet away and is invisible to most creatures.

recipes.name: Scroll of Peach’s Whisper
recipes.description: Whisper a single word that compels obedience in one creature for 6 seconds. Only works on those who once loved Princess Peach.

recipes.name: Scroll of Bowser’s Rage Echo
recipes.description: Unleash a cone of fire infused with Bowser’s fury. Deals 3d6 fire + 1d6 psychic to creatures who’ve betrayed you. Lasting fear effect on failure.

recipes.name: Scroll of Fawful’s Mind Screw
recipes.description: Target must make WIS save or believe their greatest fear is real for 1 minute. Save with disadvantage if they’ve ever worn purple.

recipes.name: Scroll of Wario’s Greed Pulse
recipes.description: Pulse emits from user — all coins within 30ft fly toward you. Creatures carrying coins take 1d4 force damage per coin (max 10).

recipes.name: Scroll of Kamek’s Temporal Glitch
recipes.description: Target creature repeats their last action. If it was an attack, they attack again. If movement, they move again. Duration: 1 round.

recipes.name: Scroll of Archie’s Third Eye Reveal
recipes.description: See through all lies, illusions, and disguises for 1 minute. Reveals hidden doors, traitors, and magical deceptions in 60ft radius.

recipes.name: Scroll of hjumpik’s Spore Nova
recipes.description: Explode in a 20ft radius cloud of hallucinogenic spores. Creatures must make CON save or suffer vivid, combat-incapacitating visions for 1 min.

recipes.name: Scroll of Eager’s Pepper Purge
recipes.description: Blast a 30ft cone of ghost pepper mist. Creatures take 2d6 fire + 2d6 poison, blinded for 1 round on failed CON save. Undead/fiends have disadvantage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Dan’s Last Heal
recipes.description: Heal target for 4d8 + spellcasting mod HP. If target is at 0 HP, they return with max HP. Usable only when crafter is near death (≤ 5 HP).

recipes.name: Scroll of Remi’s Deephold Forge Call
recipes.description: Summon spectral smithing tools. For 10 minutes, you can repair or enchant any item as if you had proficiency +10. Cannot create new items.

recipes.name: Scroll of Markop’s Shadow Clone Army
recipes.description: Create 1d4 illusory duplicates that each act independently on your turn. Each has 1 HP and vanishes when hit. Lasts 1 minute.

recipes.name: Scroll of Green T’s Venomous Wrath
recipes.description: Your next melee attack injects paralytic venom. Target must make CON save or be paralyzed for 1 min. On crit, also takes 3d6 poison.

recipes.name: Scroll of Ignis’ Dragon’s Truth
recipes.description: Ask one question — dragon spirit answers with perfect, brutal truth. Cannot lie. May refuse to answer if question threatens dragonkind.

recipes.name: Scroll of Onyx Hand Soul Bind
recipes.description: Trap the soul of a dying creature in a gem. Soul can be interrogated, used as power source, or resurrected later. Works only on willing or helpless targets.

recipes.name: Scroll of Iron Legion Mind Lock
recipes.description: Target creature cannot be charmed, frightened, or magically influenced for 1 hour. Also immune to telepathy and scrying.

recipes.name: Scroll of Raventree Mirror Step
recipes.description: Step into any mirror within 30ft and emerge from another within 500ft. Mirrors must be at least 3ft tall. Does not work across planes.

recipes.name: Scroll of Time War Fracture
recipes.description: Rip a 10ft tear in time. All creatures inside repeat their last turn. Items may duplicate or vanish. Lasts 6 seconds. Unpredictable side effects.

recipes.name: Scroll of Supernatural Sovereignty Null
recipes.description: For 1 minute, negate all effects of the Supernatural Sovereignty Act in a 100ft radius. Vampires, werewolves, etc. regain full power.

recipes.name: Scroll of Waluigi’s Chaos Luck
recipes.description: For 1 minute, all d20 rolls made by you or within 10ft of you are rolled twice. You choose whether to take highest or lowest after seeing both.

recipes.name: Scroll of X.O.’s Digital Overwrite
recipes.description: Overwrite the personality of one construct or AI. New personality obeys you. Lasts 1 day. Only works on machines with emotional capacity.

recipes.name: Scroll of Eldritch Whisper
recipes.description: Whisper a single word that only your target hears, no matter the distance. The word lingers in their mind for 1 hour, granting advantage on the next check related to that word (e.g., "bravery" for a fear save).

recipes.name: Scroll of Quantum Spark
recipes.description: Create a tiny spark that exists in two places at once. When you cast this spell, roll a d20. On an even number, the spark deals 1d4 fire damage. On an odd number, it heals 1d4 HP instead.

recipes.name: Scroll of Echo of Nothing
recipes.description: Create a perfect silence in a 5-foot radius for 1 minute. All sound within this area is absorbed, including magical effects like Thunderwave or Shatter.

recipes.name: Scroll of Phoenix Touch
recipes.description: Touch a creature to heal 1 HP. If the target is at 0 HP, they stabilize and gain 1 temporary HP. Once used, the scroll crumbles to ash.

recipes.name: Scroll of True Name Glimpse
recipes.description: For 1 round, you see the true name of one creature you can see. This name fades from your memory after 1 minute unless you succeed on an INT save (DC 15).

recipes.name: Scroll of Lario's Illusionary Double
recipes.description: Create an illusory double of yourself that lasts for 1 minute. The double mimics your actions and can take one hit before disappearing.

recipes.name: Scroll of Creek's Surgical Precision
recipes.description: Your next attack with a finesse weapon within the next minute scores a critical hit on a roll of 19-20. If the attack hits, you can choose to deal maximum damage.

recipes.name: Scroll of Galypso's Assassin Mark
recipes.description: Mark a creature within 60 feet. For 1 minute, you know the targets exact location and have advantage on attack rolls against them.

recipes.name: Scroll of Robinson's Dragon Speak
recipes.description: You can understand and speak Draconic for 1 hour. Additionally, you can communicate simple concepts with dragons and dragon-like creatures.

recipes.name: Scroll of Ironhand's Execution Order
recipes.description: Target creature must make a WIS save or be compelled to carry out a single violent command (e.g., "kill that prisoner" or "destroy that building") for 1 minute. The target has disadvantage on the save if they are part of a military hierarchy.

recipes.name: Scroll of Flame Burst
recipes.description: A burst of searing fire erupts from the caster’s hand, striking a single target and causing moderate fire damage. The flames spread outward in a 3-meter radius, igniting flammable objects.

recipes.name: Scroll of Lightning Strike
recipes.description: A bolt of raw lightning strikes the target, causing electrifying damage and stunning them for 1 round. Perfect for interrupting enemy actions.

recipes.name: Scroll of Force Bash
recipes.description: A surge of raw force shatters the target’s defenses, dealing crushing damage and pushing them back 3 meters. Ideal for breaking through enemy formations.

recipes.name: Scroll of Charm Suggestion
recipes.description: Targets one creature within range, compelling it to obey simple commands for 1 round. Ideal for guiding or redirecting hostile entities.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mind Control Basic
recipes.description: Commands a single creature to perform a simple action, overriding its will for 1 round. Effective on creatures with no resistance to charm.

recipes.name: Scroll of Suggestion Lullaby
recipes.description: A soothing melody induces a target to accept a suggestion for 1 round. Best used on creatures who are easily influenced or weary.

recipes.name: Scroll of Charm Bear
recipes.description: A spell that gently entraps a bear in a state of docile obedience, allowing the caster to command it to follow simple commands without resistance. Effective within 30 feet.

recipes.name: Scroll of Suggestion Silent
recipes.description: A spell that whispers a suggestion into the mind of a willing target, causing them to obey the caster’s command for a short duration. The target must be aware and not under another enchantment.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mind Control Silver
recipes.description: A spell that binds the target’s will for 10 minutes, forcing them to obey the caster’s command. Only works on targets with no magical resistance or protective wards.

recipes.name: Scroll of Matter Transmutation
recipes.description: Transforms one solid object into another substance of equal weight and volume. Example: turns a stone into gold or water into sand.

recipes.name: Scroll of Form Enhancement
recipes.description: Increases the size or density of an object by 20% without altering its material. Best used on armor, tools, or living creatures.

recipes.name: Scroll of State Shift
recipes.description: Changes the physical state of a substance. For example: water to ice, ice to water, or liquid to gas. Only affects pure substances.

recipes.name: Scroll of Summoning Dust Golem
recipes.description: Summons a small, dust-covered golem made of enchanted earth and ash. It stands 3 feet tall and can carry a single object or strike once with a basic earth slam.

recipes.name: Scroll of Momentary Teleportation
recipes.description: Allows the caster to teleport to a pre-determined location within 30 feet, leaving behind a faint shimmering residue. Cannot be used to teleport through solid objects or into other dimensions.

recipes.name: Scroll of Flame Candle Creation
recipes.description: Conjures a small, self-contained flame candle made of enchanted wax and spirit. Burns for 5 minutes, emits a soft glow, and can be held or placed. Cannot be extinguished by water or wind unless manually broken.

recipes.name: Scroll of Spell Name
recipes.description: Alters the elemental composition of a substance, converting it into a new form with unique properties.

recipes.name: Scroll of Flicker of Light
recipes.description: Creates a brief, shimmering illusion of light that fools the eye into seeing nonexistent illumination. Ideal for hiding in dim spaces or deceiving foes with false brightness.

recipes.name: Scroll of Shadow Glitch
recipes.description: Causes a localized area to briefly flicker into an impossible shadow form, making objects or figures appear to vanish or shift position. Perfect for misdirection or stealth.

recipes.name: Scroll of Image Fade
recipes.description: Causes a single object or surface to appear to dissolve into a ghostly, half-visible image for a brief moment. Great for hiding secrets or creating optical illusions.

recipes.name: Scroll of Death Siphon
recipes.description: Drains 1d4 hit points from a nearby living target and transfers them to the caster as temporary undead vitality. Target must be within 10 feet.

recipes.name: Scroll of Undead Tether
recipes.description: Creates a temporary bond between the caster and an undead creature, allowing control or movement enhancement. The undead must be within 10 feet and not already under another casters control.

recipes.name: Scroll of Life Drain Cascade
recipes.description: A cascade of life energy is drained from multiple targets in a 30-foot radius. Each target takes 1d6 damage and loses 1 point of vitality. Cannot target undead or creatures with regeneration.

recipes.name: Scroll of Summon Familiar
recipes.description: Summons a small, loyal creature to assist the caster. The familiar remains nearby for 3 rounds, can be commanded to deliver messages or act as a scout.

recipes.name: Scroll of Teleport Nearby
recipes.description: Instantly transports the caster to a nearby location within 30 feet. Requires line of sight and no obstacles.

recipes.name: Scroll of Create Flower
recipes.description: Creates a single, beautiful, glowing flower from the caster’s hand. The flower blooms for 3 rounds and emits a soft, calming aura. Can be planted to grow permanently if soil is present.

recipes.name: Scroll of Shield Blessing
recipes.description: Grants the caster a temporary protective barrier that absorbs 1d6 damage from one source per turn. The barrier lasts for 1 round or until dispelled.

recipes.name: Scroll of Wall of Earth
recipes.description: Creates a solid, non-lethal barrier of earth that blocks projectiles and melee attacks for 3 rounds. Can be moved as the caster moves.

recipes.name: Scroll of Ward of Light
recipes.description: Casts a glowing, protective ward that repels hostile creatures and reduces magical damage by 25% for 2 minutes. Effective against undead and magical entities.

recipes.name: Scroll of Hidden Step
recipes.description: The caster steps forward and vanishes from sight for a moment, appearing to be elsewhere. Perfect for slipping past guards or avoiding detection.

recipes.name: Scroll of Silken Gaze
recipes.description: The caster’s eyes appear to be blank or glazed, making them seem dazed or asleep. Targets may mistake them for an unconscious or ill person.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mirrored Mind
recipes.description: The caster’s thoughts are reflected as if in a mirror—anyone observing them sees a double of themself. Useful for confusing foes or deceiving observers.

recipes.name: Scroll of Summon Tiny Fae
recipes.description: Summons a small, mischievous fae spirit that dances around the caster, causing minor distractions and harmless giggles. Fae vanish when the spell ends or when the caster moves more than 10 feet.

recipes.name: Scroll of Teleport Ward
recipes.description: Creates a shimmering ward that allows the caster to teleport up to 30 feet in any direction, without needing a clear path. The ward vanishes after 30 seconds or if the caster moves out of its range.

recipes.name: Scroll of Blossom Craft
recipes.description: Causes a single, perfect flower to bloom in the caster’s hand, lasting 10 seconds. The flower can be planted to grow into a full bloom in 24 hours. Can be used to create a temporary, enchanted garden.

recipes.name: Scroll of Warded Shield
recipes.description: Creates a shimmering, glyph-etched barrier around the caster that deflects blunt and piercing attacks. The shield lasts 3 rounds and can be reinforced by casting it again after a 10-second cooldown.

recipes.name: Scroll of Barrier of Earth
recipes.description: Conjures a solid, earthbound wall of stone and root that blocks line-of-sight and physical projectiles. The barrier remains until dispelled or destroyed, and can be moved with a single action.

recipes.name: Scroll of Warded Passage
recipes.description: Forms a magical barrier that prevents entry into a designated area for 5 rounds. Can be used to seal doors, windows, or openings. Enemies attempting to enter are immediately repelled with a magical shimmer.

recipes.name: Scroll of Sight Revealer
recipes.description: Reveals the immediate surroundings within a 10-foot radius, showing hidden objects, creatures, or magical effects. Does not reveal invisible or intangible entities.

recipes.name: Scroll of Knowledge Gram
recipes.description: Grants the caster temporary knowledge of a single item, location, or event within the last 24 hours. Cannot be used on living beings or sentient entities.

recipes.name: Scroll of Prophecy Flicker
recipes.description: Briefly flashes a vision of a future event, lasting up to 10 seconds. May be inaccurate or misleading. Cannot predict the future with certainty.

recipes.name: Scroll of Deathwhisper
recipes.description: Whispering to the dead, this scroll allows the caster to speak with the spirit of a recently deceased creature, gaining insight into its final thoughts or memories.

recipes.name: Scroll of Undeadcall
recipes.description: Summons a low-level undead companion to assist the caster. The creature remains loyal for 1 turn before fading, but can be re-summoned.

recipes.name: Scroll of Life Drain
recipes.description: Drains 5 HP from the target, converting it into necrotic energy that the caster can use for 1 turn. No damage, but grants +1 to all necromantic spells cast.

recipes.name: Scroll of Fire Blast
recipes.description: A concentrated burst of infernal fire erupts from the caster’s hands, dealing significant fire damage to a single target. The blast scorches the ground and ignites nearby flammable objects.

recipes.name: Scroll of Lightning Shock
recipes.description: A crackling bolt of lightning strikes the target, dealing significant electric damage and momentarily stunning them. The shockwave radiates outward for 2 meters.

recipes.name: Scroll of Force Bolt
recipes.description: A devastating force blast is hurled from the caster’s hand, piercing through armor and dealing piercing damage. The bolt can be redirected or amplified with focus.

recipes.name: Scroll of Teleport Self
recipes.description: Instantly transports the caster to a pre-designated location within a 100-yard radius. Requires a clear path and no obstacles. Cannot teleport through solid matter.

recipes.name: Scroll of Fireblast
recipes.description: A sudden burst of searing flame erupts from the casters hand, dealing 15-20 damage to one target. Perfect for clearing obstacles or disrupting foes.

recipes.name: Scroll of Lightningstrike
recipes.description: A crackling bolt of pure electric energy strikes the target, causing 18-25 damage and stunning for 1 round. Ideal for interrupting enemy actions.

recipes.name: Scroll of Forcecrush
recipes.description: The caster channels raw magical force into a crushing blow, dealing 20-28 damage and pushing the target 2 squares backward. Useful for crowd control or breaking barriers.

recipes.name: Scroll of Undead Realm
recipes.description: Conjures a 10-foot-radius sphere of necrotic energy that grants undead allies +1d4 to attack rolls and damage rolls. Must be cast in a location with at least one corpse.

recipes.name: Scroll of Summoning Dragon
recipes.description: Summons a massive dragon from the aetheric plane, roaring with fire and fury. Must be cast in an open area. Dragon remains for 3 rounds unless dispelled.

recipes.name: Scroll of Teleportation Gate
recipes.description: Creates a shimmering portal to a preselected location within 1000 feet. Requires a clear path and must be cast at a standing position. Portal lasts 1 round.

recipes.name: Scroll of Essence Creation
recipes.description: Conjures a shimmering, temporary construct of pure essence—up to 10 feet tall—based on the caster’s will. Can be a creature, object, or abstract form. Fades after 3 rounds.

recipes.name: Scroll of Death Bite
recipes.description: A single bite from a skeletal hand drains 10 HP from a target, leaving them in a state of shock for 1 turn. Can be used on living or undead targets.

recipes.name: Scroll of Undead Ward
recipes.description: Creates a protective barrier of bone and shadow that absorbs 100 damage per hit from melee or ranged attacks. Only effective against undead or death-themed spells.

recipes.name: Scroll of Shield Bard
recipes.description: Creates a shimmering, semi-transparent barrier around the caster that deflects minor physical attacks and reduces incoming damage by 25%. Lasts for 3 rounds.

recipes.name: Scroll of Warding Wall
recipes.description: Creates a solid, magical barrier that blocks all non-magical physical attacks and projectiles within a 3-meter radius. The barrier lasts for 3 rounds or until broken.

recipes.name: Scroll of Protective Aura
recipes.description: Emits a gentle, glowing field around the caster, reducing incoming damage by 30% for 15 seconds. Does not negate critical hits or magical effects.

recipes.name: Scroll of Shield Barrier
recipes.description: Creates a small, shimmering barrier of force that protects the caster from incoming physical damage for 10 seconds. Effective against blunt, piercing, and slashing attacks.

recipes.name: Scroll of Warded Gate
recipes.description: Casts a temporary magical seal on a door or portal, preventing entry or exit for 30 seconds. Ideal for blocking intruders or securing exits.

recipes.name: Scroll of Undead Blood
recipes.description: Siphons a single drop of blood from the target, converting it into a temporary undead enhancement for the caster. Grants +2 to all undead-based attacks for 3 turns.

recipes.name: Scroll of Guardian Ward
recipes.description: Installs a protective ward that continuously checks for intruders and emits a warning sound if any hostile creature enters the 5-meter radius. Wards last for 5 rounds.

recipes.name: Scroll of Charm Mind
recipes.description: Targets one creature within range, causing them to be charmed and obey simple commands for 1 round. Creature must be within 10 feet and not immune to charm effects.

recipes.name: Scroll of Suggestion Illusion
recipes.description: Targets one creature within range, causing them to believe a false statement for 1 round. The target must be able to hear and comprehend the suggestion. No effect on immune targets.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mind Control Echo
recipes.description: Targets one creature within range, causing them to obey simple commands for 1 round. The target must be within 10 feet and not immune to mind control.

recipes.name: Scroll of Silence of the Soul
recipes.description: Targets one creature within range, causing it to be unable to speak or make noise for 1 round. Perfect for ambush or stealth operations.

recipes.name: Scroll of Invisible Maneuver
recipes.description: Grants the caster temporary invisibility for 1 round, allowing them to move undetected through hostile terrain or ambush targets.

recipes.name: Scroll of Flicker Image
recipes.description: Creates a shifting image that mimics a target’s appearance for 1 round, fooling observers into believing the target is elsewhere. Great for misleading foes.

recipes.name: Scroll of Force Crush
recipes.description: A sudden surge of raw force shatters the target’s defenses, dealing heavy damage and forcing them to stagger backward. This spell ignores minor armor and resistance.

recipes.name: Scroll of Soul Charm
recipes.description: Targets a living creature and compels it to obey the casters whispered command for 1 round. Fails if the target is immune to charm or has high willpower.

recipes.name: Scroll of Mind Control
recipes.description: Imposes mental domination over a target, overriding its will for 1 round. Fails if target is resistant or if caster is not focused.

recipes.name: Scroll of Suggestion Temptation
recipes.description: Influences a target to act against its better judgment, based on the casters suggestion. Requires a successful persuasion check or target must be susceptible to suggestion.

recipes.name: Scroll of Sight Beyond
recipes.description: Reveals the immediate surroundings as if through a crystal lens. Reveals hidden objects, traps, or obstacles within 30 feet. Visual effect lasts for 1 round.

recipes.name: Scroll of Knowledge Ancient
recipes.description: Reveals the most recent event that occurred within a 30-foot radius, as if recorded in a forgotten diary. May reveal a creature’s last known action, a hidden path, or a forgotten fact.

recipes.name: Scroll of Prophecy Fate
recipes.description: Displays a single, brief prophecy about the immediate future. The prophecy is vague, poetic, or cryptic, but reveals a turning point or omen that may be interpreted as a sign or warning.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Squeaky Steps
recipes.description: Boots emit a loud squeak with every step. Disadvantage on Stealth checks involving movement.
recipes.schoolReason: Boots emit a loud squeak with every step, disadvantaging Stealth checks.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Misprinted Nameplate
recipes.description: Item’s engraved name constantly shifts to mildly embarrassing typos.
recipes.schoolReason: Item’s engraved name constantly shifts to mildly embarrassing typos affecting others.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Mirage
recipes.description: Cloak creates faint illusory duplicates, granting slight advantage to hide in crowds.
recipes.schoolReason: Cloak creates faint illusory duplicates to deceive senses.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Phase Blade
recipes.description: Blade can pass through non-magical metal and wood once per short rest.
recipes.schoolReason: Blade can pass through non-magical metal and wood by manipulating its properties.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Echoing Voice
recipes.description: Helm amplifies the wearer’s voice dramatically. Great for speeches, terrible for stealth.
recipes.schoolReason: Amplifies the wearer’s voice, affecting others with its sound.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Token of Luck
recipes.description: Once per day, the wearer may reroll a failed ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.
recipes.schoolReason: Allows the wearer to reroll failed checks, affecting outcomes of rolls.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Glowing
recipes.description: Armor sheds dim light in a 10ft radius.
recipes.schoolReason: Armor sheds dim light in a 10ft radius.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Paper Cut
recipes.description: Weapon deals +1 slashing damage to creatures with 0 HP (over-kill only).
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon deals +1 slashing damage to creatures with 0 HP.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Lint Magnets
recipes.description: Socks attract pocket lint; disadvantage on Sleight of Hand to hide items.
recipes.schoolReason: Socks attract lint, imposing disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Minor Ear-Wiggle
recipes.description: Helmet allows voluntary ear wiggling. Impress children.
recipes.schoolReason: Helmet allows voluntary ear wiggling, affecting others' perception.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Always Damp
recipes.description: Towel is permanently moist. Mildew smell included.
recipes.schoolReason: Towel is permanently moist; Enchantment affects the minds of others.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Glitter Burst
recipes.description: On hit weapon explodes glitter (5-ft radius); targets have disadvantage on next Stealth.
recipes.schoolReason: Targets have disadvantage on next Stealth check.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Reverse Handle
recipes.description: Weapon grip faces backward; attack rolls at disadvantage unless user succeeds DC 15 DEX check each round.
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon grip faces backward; attack rolls at disadvantage unless user succeeds DC 15 DEX check each round.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Auto-Lace
recipes.description: Boots tie themselves. Takes 1 round; interrupts stealth if rushed.
recipes.schoolReason: Boots tie themselves, affecting the mind to automate actions.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Mood Armor
recipes.description: Armor changes color with wearer’s emotions. Allies gain advantage on Insight vs. wearer.
recipes.schoolReason: Allies gain advantage on Insight vs. wearer, affecting others' perception.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Burp Shield
recipes.description: Shield emits loud belch when struck; foes within 5 ft make DC 12 CON save or be deafened 1 round.
recipes.schoolReason: Foes within range must save against enchantment to avoid being deafened.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Recursive Mirror
recipes.description: Shield reflects user’s own image infinitely; user has disadvantage on saves vs. gaze attacks.
recipes.schoolReason: Reflects user’s own image infinitely; disadvantage on saves vs. gaze attacks.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Blood Pact Blade
recipes.description: Weapon deals +2d6 damage but user takes half that much recoil.
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon deals +2d6 damage but user takes half that much recoil.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Entropy Plate
recipes.description: Armor grants +2 AC but halves all healing received.
recipes.schoolReason: Armor grants +2 AC but halves all healing received.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Gamble Greaves
recipes.description: Each stride: 50 % speed bonus or 50 % fall prone. Roll 1d2.
recipes.schoolReason: Roll 1d2 for speed bonus or fall prone, affecting the wearer's movement.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Rust Lover
recipes.description: Weapon gains +1d6 vs. metal foes but itself rusts: −1 to hit cumulatively each hit (permanent).
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon gains +1d6 vs. metal foes but itself rusts: −1 to hit cumulatively each hit (permanent).

recipes.name: Enchantment: Soul Snare Ring
recipes.description: Killing blow traps soul in gem (DM control). Each dawn DC 18 CHA save or alignment shifts one step toward evil.
recipes.schoolReason: Each dawn DC 18 CHA save or alignment shifts one step toward evil.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Steam Step
recipes.description: Leave 5-ft steam cloud (lightly obscured) each move; disperses after 1 round.
recipes.schoolReason: Leaves a steam cloud that obscures vision for others.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Obsidian Edge
recipes.description: Weapon crits on 19-20 vs. creatures with shield or armor, but shatters on nat 1 (destroyed).
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon crits on specific rolls, affecting the combat outcomes.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Magnet Pulse
recipes.description: Once per short rest pull metal weapon 10 ft (STR contest). User drops own metal items on fail.
recipes.schoolReason: Forces user to drop metal items on failed STR contest.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Crystal Echo
recipes.description: Spells cast through staff repeat at 50 % power next round (targets same area). Uncontrolled.
recipes.schoolReason: Spells cast through staff repeat at reduced power, affecting the targets.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Mud Shell
recipes.description: Armor grants +2 AC while stationary; halves speed while moving. Washes off in rain.
recipes.schoolReason: Armor grants +2 AC while stationary; halves speed while moving.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Squeaky Minion
recipes.description: Toy mouse animates (tiny construct, 1 HP). Squeaks when enemies near. Dies in one hit.
recipes.schoolReason: Squeaks when enemies near, affecting minds with sound.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Pocket Spider
recipes.description: Produces harmless spider once per day. Spider obeys simple commands (no combat).
recipes.schoolReason: Produces a creature under simple command, affecting its mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Parrot Perch Helm
recipes.description: Helmet sprouts perch; spectral parrot repeats last phrase spoken. Vanishes if insulted.
recipes.schoolReason: Spectral parrot repeats last phrase spoken, affecting minds.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Fetch Disc
recipes.description: Throwing disc returns automatically; 50 % chance to hit thrower instead.
recipes.schoolReason: It enchants a disc to return and potentially hit the thrower.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Emotional-Support Slime
recipes.description: Small slime lives in jar. Grants +1 to saves vs. fear while held. Cries when lonely.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants +1 to saves vs. fear while held.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Time Slice
recipes.description: Once per long rest weapon deletes target from timeline for 1 round (CHA save DC 20). On fail user ages 1d10 years.
recipes.schoolReason: User ages 1d10 years on fail, affecting user's mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Divine Petition
recipes.description: Armor allows 1 wish/year. Each use: 10 % chance deity claims user’s soul (no save).
recipes.schoolReason: Armor allows a wish/year with chance deity claims user’s soul.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Blackhole Quiver
recipes.description: Arrows create 5-ft-radius micro-singularity (pull 15 ft, 4d6 force, DC 18). Destroys arrows. 1/day.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce a micro-singularity pulling arrows in.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Infinity Pouch
recipes.description: Holds 1000 lbs, 500 cu ft. 1 % chance per use to lose item in astral void forever.
recipes.schoolReason: Holds 1000 lbs, 500 cu ft.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Phoenix Core
recipes.description: Spells deal +2d6 fire and caster auto-resurrects 1/day at 1 HP (staff destroyed).
recipes.schoolReason: Caster auto-resurrects self, affecting the mind by ensuring survival.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Bait Helm
recipes.description: Helmet smells delicious; predators have advantage on attacks vs. wearer.
recipes.schoolReason: Helmet smells delicious; predators have advantage on attacks vs. wearer.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Klepto Gloves
recipes.description: Advantage on Sleight of Hand, but must steal something valuable each dawn or gloves steal from owner.
recipes.schoolReason: Enables advantage on Sleight of Hand but compels stealing valuable items.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Loud Snore Mail
recipes.description: Armor produces 90 dB snores when wearer sleeps. Party surprise impossible.
recipes.schoolReason: Armor affects others with loud snores when wearer sleeps.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Procrastination Quill
recipes.description: Writing takes 10× time; user must succeed DC 15 WIS save to finish any written task.
recipes.schoolReason: Writing takes 10× time; user must succeed DC 15 WIS save to finish any written task.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Inversion Cape
recipes.description: Cape inverts cardinal directions for wearer; Navigation checks at disadvantage.
recipes.schoolReason: Navigation checks at disadvantage, affecting the wearer's mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Holiday Jingles
recipes.description: Boots play random carols each step. Volume increases in stealth.
recipes.schoolReason: Boots play random carols each step, affecting the minds via sound.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Loading Screen
recipes.description: Once per day user freezes in T-pose for 3 rounds (stunned) while “loading” buff: +5 to next attack roll.
recipes.schoolReason: Once per day user is stunned while gaining +5 to next attack roll.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Fourth-Wall Hammer
recipes.description: On nat 20 user addresses camera, granting inspiration to allies (DM gives token). On nat 1 user insults DM and suffers −2 to all rolls until apology.
recipes.schoolReason: On nat 20 user addresses camera, granting inspiration to allies.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Unsubscribe Cloak
recipes.description: Once per long rest wearer may “unsubscribe” from one spell effect (automatically ends on them). Cloak then spams magical junk mail for 1 minute (minor illusions).
recipes.schoolReason: Wearer’s mind is affected to unsubscribe from a spell effect.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Potion-Slot Belt
recipes.description: Belt holds 3 potions. Drinking randomly selects one (DM chooses). 5 % chance belt eats potion and burps.
recipes.schoolReason: Belt affects minds by randomly selecting a potion.

recipes.name: Unstable Frag Grenade
recipes.description: 30-ft radius explosion (4d6 fire/piercing, DEX save DC 14 half). 20% backfire chance on throw.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates fire/piercing energy into an explosion.

recipes.name: Hellfire Bomb
recipes.description: 20-ft cone fire blast (6d6 fire, ignites for 1d6/turn). 30% chance to ignite crafter on failure.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce a 20-ft cone fire blast.

recipes.name: Chain Reaction Mine
recipes.description: Triggers chain explosions in 15-ft radius (3d8 force x number of enemies). 50% chain to allies on fail.
recipes.schoolReason: Triggers chain explosions in a radius, manipulating energy for force effects.

recipes.name: Void Implosion Orb
recipes.description: Pulls creatures 20 ft into center (5d10 force, STR save). Failure summons void wisp (hostile).
recipes.schoolReason: Pulls creatures into center with force damage, manipulating energy.

recipes.name: Alchemist's Folly
recipes.description: Random explosion: acid, fire, or poison (roll d6 for type, 4d6 dmg). 40% random on crafter.
recipes.schoolReason: Random explosion: acid, fire, or poison.

recipes.name: Bloodthirst Dagger
recipes.description: +2d4 necrotic dmg, heals user. After 3 uses: cursed (vampirism, sunlight vulnerability).
recipes.schoolReason: Heals user and deals necrotic damage, manipulating life and death.

recipes.name: Doom Shield
recipes.description: +2 AC, absorbs 10 dmg/turn. Curse: attracts undead (1d4 skeletons/day).
recipes.schoolReason: +2 AC, absorbs 10 dmg/turn: Protective magic creating a barrier.

recipes.name: Ring of Madness
recipes.description: Advantage on INS checks. Curse: random insanity (short-term madness 1/hour).
recipes.schoolReason: Advantage on INS checks. Curse: random insanity.

recipes.name: Plague Bracers
recipes.description: Melee hits apply disease (DC 15 CON or poisoned 1 min). Curse: carrier (spread to allies).
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates life and death energy by spreading disease.

recipes.name: Amulet of Betrayal
recipes.description: +3 CHA (Persuasion/Deception). Curse: 10% chance ally attacks you instead.
recipes.schoolReason: +3 CHA (Persuasion/Deception) with a curse that makes allies attack you.

recipes.name: Demon Summoning Trap
recipes.description: Trap summons quasit (hostile to all but caster). DC 16 INT (Arcana) to control.
recipes.schoolReason: Trap summons quasit (hostile to all but caster).

recipes.name: Spirit Bomb
recipes.description: Releases 2d4 specters (50% friendly, 50% hostile). 8d6 necrotic in 20 ft.
recipes.schoolReason: Releases specters and deals necrotic damage.

recipes.name: Elemental Cage Trap
recipes.description: Traps victim in elemental cage (random: fire/air/etc., 4d8 dmg/turn). 30% breaks free early.
recipes.schoolReason: Traps victim in elemental cage dealing 4d8 damage per turn.

recipes.name: Beast Caller Horn
recipes.description: Summons 1d6 beasts (CR 1/4). 40% berserk (attack nearest).
recipes.schoolReason: Summons 1d6 beasts (CR 1/4).

recipes.name: Unstable Arcane Bomb
recipes.description: A volatile explosive that deals 6d6 force damage in 20-ft radius. On crafting failure, explodes immediately.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce a force-damage explosion.

recipes.name: Soulbound Curse Idol
recipes.description: Place this idol to curse an area: all within 30 ft suffer -2 to saves vs magic. If crafting fails, YOU become cursed instead.
recipes.schoolReason: causes a -2 penalty to saves vs magic for those within the area

recipes.name: Chaos Grenade
recipes.description: On detonation, roll on Wild Magic Surge table. On crafting failure, surge affects the crafter immediately.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce effects on detonation.

recipes.name: Rift Key
recipes.description: Opens a 10-ft portal to a random plane for 1 minute. On failure, opens a permanent unstable rift nearby.
recipes.schoolReason: Opens a portal to a random plane, transporting one through dimensions.

recipes.name: Probability Dice
recipes.description: Once per day, replace any d20 roll with this die — but the universe balances it by cursing your next roll with disadvantage for a week.
recipes.schoolReason: It manipulates fate through a d20 roll, affecting future outcomes.

recipes.name: Echo Mirror
recipes.description: Gaze into mirror to create a temporary duplicate of yourself (lasts 1 min, follows basic commands). On failure, it becomes autonomous… and hostile.
recipes.schoolReason: Creates a duplicate under basic commands, affecting the mind of the autonomous copy.

recipes.name: Minor Demon Pact Seal
recipes.description: Grants +2 to STR and resistance to fire for 24 hours. On failure, a Quasit appears and claims your next meal… or finger.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants temporary STR bonus and fire resistance, affecting the mind through a pact.

recipes.name: Void Totem
recipes.description: Place totem to gain darkvision 60 ft and resistance to psychic damage for 1 hour. On failure, attract a Void Entity that stalks you for 1d4 days.
recipes.schoolReason: Gains resistance to psychic damage.

recipes.name: Necrotic Anchor
recipes.description: Prevents death once: when reduced to 0 HP, stabilize at 1 HP. On failure, your soul is tethered — you rise as a Specter under DM control in 1d4 hours.
recipes.schoolReason: Tethers the soul and turns the user into a Specter upon death.

recipes.name: Fleshweaver Serum
recipes.description: Gain +2 CON and regeneration 1 HP/round for 1 hour. On failure, roll on Mutation Table (permanent unless cured).
recipes.schoolReason: Gain +2 CON and regeneration; affects the mind via temporary buffs.

recipes.name: Chimeric Elixir
recipes.description: Gain flight (30 ft), blindsight 10 ft, and +1d6 poison damage on unarmed strikes for 10 minutes. On failure, grow mismatched limbs or features for 1d4 days.
recipes.schoolReason: Gains flight, blindsight, and poison damage on strikes.

recipes.name: Mindspike Implant
recipes.description: Implant grants +2 INT and telepathy 30 ft for 24 hours. On failure, suffer psychic feedback: 3d6 damage and confusion for 1 minute.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants intelligence boost and telepathy, affecting the mind.

recipes.name: Plague Smoke Bomb
recipes.description: Creates a 20-ft cloud of disease-ridden fog. Creatures inside must save or gain poisoned condition. On failure, cloud centers on YOU.
recipes.schoolReason: Creates a cloud of disease-ridden fog to affect creatures.

recipes.name: Gravity Well Grenade
recipes.description: Creates a 10-ft sphere of crushing gravity. All inside take 4d10 bludgeoning and are restrained. On failure, well forms around crafter.
recipes.schoolReason: Creates a sphere of crushing gravity manipulating energy.

recipes.name: Silence Burst Charge
recipes.description: Detonates in 15-ft radius: all creatures are silenced (can’t cast spells with verbal components) for 1 minute. On failure, only YOU are affected.
recipes.schoolReason: Detonates to silence all creatures, affecting verbal spell components.

recipes.name: Gambler’s Token
recipes.description: Once per day, force a reroll of any die — yours or an enemy’s. On failure, the token curses you: all rolls are replaced with 1s for 24 hours.
recipes.schoolReason: Forces a reroll and curses the target with 1s on rolls.

recipes.name: Fate Coin
recipes.description: Flip to invoke good OR bad luck for next hour (your choice). On failure, the coin chooses FOR you — and it’s always bad.
recipes.schoolReason: It affects the user's luck by choice or compulsion.

recipes.name: Whispering Mask
recipes.description: Wearer gains advantage on Deception and Intimidation. On failure, mask bonds to face and whispers paranoid secrets day and night.
recipes.schoolReason: Whispers paranoid secrets day and night, affecting the wearer's mind.

recipes.name: Blood Quill
recipes.description: Writes with your own blood — no ink needed. Grants advantage on Forgery. On failure, quill becomes parasitic and drains 1 HP per page written.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants advantage on Forgery and alters mental state on failure.

recipes.name: Eye of the Void
recipes.description: Grants truesight 30 ft for 1 minute once per day. On failure, you glimpse the Void — gain indefinite madness and attract a Star Spawn in 1d4 days.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants truesight, revealing hidden information.

recipes.name: Black Star Amulet
recipes.description: Absorbs one spell targeting you per day. On failure, amulet backfires — you must cast the absorbed spell on yourself or nearest ally.
recipes.schoolReason: Absorbs spells targeting you, creating a protective effect.

recipes.name: Overclock Core
recipes.description: Install to gain +10 speed and +2 INT for 1 hour. On failure, system crashes: stunned for 1d4 rounds and 2 levels of exhaustion.
recipes.schoolReason: Installs to enhance speed and intelligence, affecting the mind.

recipes.name: Neural Jammer
recipes.description: Disrupts one creature’s concentration within 30 ft (no save). On failure, jammer backfires — YOU lose concentration and take 2d6 psychic damage.
recipes.schoolReason: Disrupts concentration by affecting the mind of a creature.

recipes.name: Dragon Soul Engine
recipes.description: Powers a vehicle or golem with draconic fury. Grants flight and fire breath weapon. On failure, awakens as sentient Dragon Golem that considers you its parent… or prey.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants flight and fire breath weapon, manipulating energy.

recipes.name: Apocalypse Trigger
recipes.description: When activated, causes localized natural disaster (earthquake, storm, eruption). On failure, disaster triggers immediately upon crafting completion.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates natural disasters to produce localized effects.

recipes.name: Undead Reviver
recipes.description: Animates 1 corpse as zombie. 50% chance its *your* loyal zombie... or not.
recipes.schoolReason: Animates a corpse as zombie, manipulating life and death.

recipes.name: Overcharge Battery
recipes.description: Powers spell 2x (double dmg/range). 25% overload (2d10 lightning to user).
recipes.schoolReason: Powers spell 2x (double dmg/range), manipulating energy to produce effects.

recipes.name: Portable Teleporter (Misfire Risk)
recipes.description: Teleport 100 ft. 30% misfire (random location, 3d6 fall dmg possible).
recipes.schoolReason: Teleports objects and creates a misfire risk.

recipes.name: Experimental Shrink Ray
recipes.description: Reduce target size (Tiny, 1 min). 20% rebounds on user.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce the effect of shrinking targets.

recipes.name: Force Field Generator
recipes.description: 10-ft force dome (blocks attacks 3 rounds). 40% collapses inward (2d8 force).
recipes.schoolReason: Blocks attacks and negates harmful effects.

recipes.name: Mind Probe Helmet
recipes.description: Read surface thoughts (DC 15 WIS save). 25% feedback (short-term madness).
recipes.schoolReason: Reads surface thoughts and causes short-term madness, affecting minds.

recipes.name: Mutation Serum
recipes.description: Gain random mutation (+2 STR *or* tentacles *or* extra eye). Roll table; 50% harmful.
recipes.schoolReason: Gain random mutation (+2 STR *or* tentacles *or* extra eye).

recipes.name: Time Bomb Potion
recipes.description: Drink: age 1d10 years *or* de-age. 30% paradox (swap age with target).
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates time by aging or de-aging the target.

recipes.name: Curse Jar
recipes.description: Traps curse from target. 40% curse transfers to opener.
recipes.schoolReason: 40% curse transfers to opener, affecting the target's mind.

recipes.name: Rage Elixir
recipes.description: +4 STR, frenzy attack. Ends: exhaustion lvl 3. 20% permanent rage.
recipes.schoolReason: +4 STR, frenzy attack; ends with exhaustion: mind-affecting

recipes.name: Soul Stealer Vial
recipes.description: Steals soul on kill (for necromancy). Break: releases all as ghosts.
recipes.schoolReason: Steals soul on kill (for necromancy).

recipes.name: Laughing Gas Trap
recipes.description: 20-ft cloud: incapacitated laughing (1 min, CON save). 25% affects whole room.
recipes.schoolReason: Induces laughter through a mind-affecting effect.

recipes.name: Acid Spike Pit
recipes.description: Fall: 3d6 piercing + 4d6 acid. 30% acid sprays back.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce effects: acid and piercing damage.

recipes.name: Illusion Maze Generator
recipes.description: Creates endless maze illusion (lost 1 hour). 40% real teleport.
recipes.schoolReason: Creates endless maze illusion (lost 1 hour).

recipes.name: Panic Button
recipes.description: Emergency: teleport 60 ft away. 50% swaps with random enemy.
recipes.schoolReason: Emergency: teleport 60 ft away.

recipes.name: Fake Treasure Chest Trap
recipes.description: Opens to mimic mouth (4d8 bite + swallow). Gold illusion.
recipes.schoolReason: Gold illusion mimics a mouth to deceive senses.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Godslayer Edge
recipes.description: Weapon bypasses divine resistance and deals +3d10 radiant on hit to celestials/fey/undead. Once per week.
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon deals +3d10 radiant damage to celestials/fey/undead.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Chronos Belt
recipes.description: Once per long rest, rewind time 6 seconds (undo one action or damage).
recipes.schoolReason: Undoing actions or negating damage affects minds by altering reality.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Omniscient Lens
recipes.description: Glasses reveal creature stats, weaknesses, and hidden items in line of sight (3/day).
recipes.schoolReason: Reveals creature stats, weaknesses, and hidden items.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Dragonheart Pauldrons
recipes.description: On death, explode in 20-ft fire burst (8d6) and resurrect with 1 HP after 1 min (once ever).
recipes.schoolReason: Resurrects with 1 HP after exploding in fire burst.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Infinite Quiver
recipes.description: Never runs out of arrows. Arrows return after 1 minute if not destroyed.
recipes.schoolReason: Never runs out of arrows; affects the minds of others by ensuring a constant supply.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Anti-Gravity Boots
recipes.description: Walk on walls/ceilings for 1 min/day. Must concentrate or fall.
recipes.schoolReason: Walk on walls/ceilings requires concentration, affecting the mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Truth Mirror
recipes.description: Mirror reveals true form of shapeshifters, illusions, or possessed beings when gazed into.
recipes.schoolReason: Mirror reveals true form, affecting perception.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Pocket Dimension Bag
recipes.description: Bag holds 10x normal capacity. Retrieving item requires DC 12 DEX check or take 1 round.
recipes.schoolReason: Bag holds 10x normal capacity, changing the property of the object.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Language Locket
recipes.description: Grants fluency in one random language for 1 hour/day. Changes daily.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants fluency in a language by affecting the mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Alarm Ward
recipes.description: Item emits loud chime if touched by unauthorized creature (you define “authorized”).
recipes.schoolReason: Item emits loud chime if touched by unauthorized creature.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Vampiric Curse
recipes.description: Heals you for damage dealt... but you must drink blood within 1 hour or suffer 2d10 necrotic.
recipes.schoolReason: Heals you for damage dealt but you must drink blood within 1 hour.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Berserker Rage
recipes.description: On hit, gain +2d6 damage next attack — but must attack nearest creature (friend or foe).
recipes.schoolReason: On hit, gain +2d6 damage next attack and must attack nearest creature.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Gravity Flip
recipes.description: On command, flip gravity in 30-ft radius for 1 round. Everyone falls upward. Save DC 15 or take 2d6.
recipes.schoolReason: Manipulates energy to produce effects, flipping gravity.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Mimic Touch
recipes.description: Weapon transforms into random object (chair, fish, boot) on critical miss. Lasts 1 hour.
recipes.schoolReason: Weapon transforms minds into random object on critical miss.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Luck Drain
recipes.description: Reroll any die once/day — but roll with disadvantage for next 24 hours.
recipes.schoolReason: Rerolls dice with a mind-affecting daily effect.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Chicken Caller
recipes.description: Blows a whistle that summons 1d4 non-hostile chickens. They follow you for 1 hour.
recipes.schoolReason: Blows a whistle that summons chickens to follow the caster.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Dramatic Cape
recipes.description: Cape billows dramatically even indoors. Grants advantage on Performance checks involving flair.
recipes.schoolReason: Grants advantage on Performance checks involving flair.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Sneeze Arrow
recipes.description: On hit, target must sneeze loudly (no mechanical effect, but breaks stealth).
recipes.schoolReason: On hit, target must sneeze loudly (no mechanical effect, but breaks stealth).

recipes.name: Enchantment: Musical Armor
recipes.description: Armor plays elevator music when moving. Can be turned off… but it misses you.
recipes.schoolReason: Armor plays elevator music when moving, affecting the mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Self-Compliment Ring
recipes.description: Whispers compliments to wearer every 10 minutes. “You look amazing today!”
recipes.schoolReason: Whispers compliments to wearer, affecting the mind.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Void Walker Boots
recipes.description: Step through shadows: teleport 30 ft as bonus action if starting/ending in dim light (3/day).
recipes.schoolReason: Teleports the wearer as if using conjuration magic.

recipes.name: Enchantment: Royal Decree Amulet
